status: written before any experiment in this directory was executed; no simulation output existed at write time

confirmatory_endpoint.per_episode_outcome: completion_rate = fraction of the 4 airframes whose first entry into the capture ball (|pos - target| < success_radius_m) occurs before the horizon T; the drone is frozen after first entry, exactly as run_experiment.run_episode computes it
confirmatory_endpoint.paired_contrast: wind_aware minus baseline completion_rate at the same (force, seed[, setting]); the seed fixes the scene and the drawn wind heading for both arms
confirmatory_endpoint.unit_of_analysis: seed (episode pair); episodes are never pooled across seeds as independent units; per-drone outcomes are only used in the A3 logistic fit with seed-clustered standard errors
confirmatory_endpoint.primary_test: exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on seed-level paired deltas, zero differences removed (scipy.stats.wilcoxon, zero_method='wilcox', correction=False, method='exact'), as in analyze.py / analyze_revision_*.py
confirmatory_endpoint.secondary_test: exact two-sided sign test (binomial on the number of positive vs negative non-zero paired deltas)
confirmatory_endpoint.interval: 95% t interval on the paired delta (as analyze_revision_radius.summarize_pair) AND 95% percentile bootstrap over seeds, 10000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20260907)

knee_definitions.knee_first_below_0p5: smallest ladder force at which an arm's mean completion over seeds is < 0.5
knee_definitions.knee_F50_interp: force at which the arm's mean completion crosses 0.5, linearly interpolated between adjacent ladder levels
knee_definitions.force_of_peak_gain: ladder force at which the mean paired gain (aware minus baseline) is largest

P1.experiment: A1 baseline integral gain / clamp sweep
P1.statement: With I_COEFF_FOR raised to 0.20 N/(m s) (clamp 2) or the xy integral clamp raised to 8 m s (Ki 0.05), the baseline arm completes at 0.15 N (mean completion >= 0.5) and the wind-aware minus baseline paired gain at 0.15 N falls from about +0.55 (stock) to about 0.
P1.confirm_rule: CONFIRMED if for the (Ki=0.20, clamp=2) and/or (Ki=0.05, clamp=8) settings the paired gain at 0.15 N has |mean| <= 0.15 with a 95% CI that includes 0, and baseline completion >= 0.5; REFUTED if gain stays >= 0.4 with CI excluding 0 for both; otherwise MIXED

P2.statement: The baseline knee force rises with horizon T and the wind-aware advantage at 0.15 N vanishes by T ~ 9 s.
P2.confirm_rule: CONFIRMED if the baseline knee (F50) is non-decreasing in T and the gain at 0.15 N for T = 10 and 12 s has |mean| <= 0.15 with CI including 0; REFUTED if gain at T >= 10 s stays >= 0.4 with CI excluding 0; otherwise MIXED

P3.experiment: A3 fine force ladder 0.10-0.20 N step 0.01, stock controller, T = 6 s
P3.statement: The completion transition is a sigmoid roughly 0.05 N wide (10-90 % width) on a 0.01 N ladder, not a one-level (0.05 N grid) step.
P3.confirm_rule: CONFIRMED if the fitted logistic 10-90 % width for the baseline arm lies in [0.02, 0.09] N and at least two 0.01 N levels have mean completion strictly between 0.1 and 0.9; REFUTED if the width is < 0.01 N (single-level step); otherwise MIXED

P4.statement: The force of peak paired advantage (and the baseline knee) tracks the capture radius one-for-one: F*[N] ~ r_c[m], i.e. slope ~ 1 N/m.
P4.confirm_rule: CONFIRMED if the OLS slope of the baseline knee F50 (interpolated) on r_c has a 95% CI that contains 1.0 and the point estimate lies in [0.6, 1.4]; REFUTED if the CI excludes [0.6, 1.4]; otherwise MIXED. The peak-gain force is reported alongside but is quantised to the 0.05 N ladder

P5.experiment: A4 crash and post-completion accounting from saved trajectories
P5.statement: At >= 0.20 N at least 30 % of drones never approach within 0.5 m of their target (crash regime), in both arms; finished drones are uncontrolled and lose altitude after completion.
P5.confirm_rule: CONFIRMED if the pooled per-drone fraction with closest approach > 0.5 m over forces >= 0.20 N is >= 0.30 in each arm; REFUTED if < 0.15; otherwise MIXED

A7.instrumentation: runtime wrapper around run_experiment.hungarian_assign recording the used assignment, the Euclidean assignment and the true-wind-penalised assignment at t = 0 and at every 1 s replan

constraints.monkey_patch_only: run_experiment.DSLPIDControl, run_experiment.DURATION_SEC, run_experiment.hungarian_assign, run_experiment.WindyCtrlAviary are replaced at runtime inside the driver process; source files untouched
